task.title: Fix Autofill Issues
task.shortdesc: Learn how to fix issues when autofill is not working.

section.p: If Chrome is not suggesting your saved info:

step.p: Make sure that Save and fill is turned on for the info that you want to autofill.
Confirm the name and email shared from your Google Account for autofill at myaccount.google.com/personal-info.

Confirm the information that you want to populate is saved, then select More
Passwords and autofill .
If your login credentials fail, like passkeys or PINs, Chrome can't access your sensitive info. Learn how to fix issues with passwords and passkeys.

ul.li: If the website is secure, Chrome may not be able to detect certain fields in the form.
If the website is not secure enough, it may not be able to receive info from Chrome.

step.p: To allow autofill to use info from Google Wallet, make sure that Use passes across Google is turned on.
